rationale: Actual failure PNG reports body-overlap placement rejection, with103 mined and13 placed. The planner repeatedly fills nearest exposed surfaces from an unchanged pit position and never moves/returns. Reconstructing the recorded voxel removals and13 adjacent placements with recorded selected material2 yields354 candidate center aims, all rejected because the next cell intersects the hidden body; this is correct collision protection. Normal return-to-surface retains inventory/world/stats and exposes54 legal center aims in the synthetic reconstruction. The probe needs normal relocation and a build order that avoids enclosing the player, rather than disabling body-overlap checks or changing free sandbox rules. There is no demonstrated product placement failure beyond the expected local enclosure. Ordinary-input rerun must still validate return and50 total placements.
